title: Cauthon Drinks
description: A custom drinks plugin for Cauthon Series
body:
## Cauthon Drinks
This plugin was not public before now on, With some small configurations we decided to let it public.

This plugin is basically adding custom potions (Drinkables)

There is a template in the plugin folder.

Supports HEX and Color Codes.

Commands:
1. /cauthondrinks reload: Reloads configurations, Adds new drinks if there are new files.
2. /cauthondrinks give: Gives the drink with command. Note: the name of the drink is the file name.

We have a discord now!!! [https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD](https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD)
